  struct ChainIter<I, J>

  struct FilterIter<I>
  struct MapIter<I, O>

  struct TakeIter<I>
  struct ZipIter<I, J>

  FilterIter<I>: implements Iterator<I::Item>
  MapIter<I, O>: implements Iterator<O>
  SkipIter<I>: implements Iterator<A>
  TakeIter<I>: implements Iterator<A>
  ZipIter<I, J>: implements Iterator<Pair<A, O>>
  ChainIter::new(first: I, second: J) -> ChainIter<I, J>

  FilterIter::new(inner: I, pred: (&I::Item) -> boolean) -> FilterIter<I>

  Iterator.any(mut &this, pred: (This::Item) -> boolean) -> boolean

  Iterator.count(mut &this) -> i64

  Iterator.map<B>(this, f: (This::Item) -> B) -> MapIter<This, B>
  Iterator.max(mut &this) -> Option<This::Item> where This::Item: Ord
  Iterator.min(mut &this) -> Option<This::Item> where This::Item: Ord

  enum Result<T, E>
  Result<T, E>: implements Clone
  Result<T, E>: implements Eq
  Result<T, E>: implements Try
  Result.and_then<U>(&this, op: (T) -> Result<U, E>) -> Result<U, E>
  Result.as_ref(&this) -> Result<T*, E*>
  Result.contains(&this, value: &T) -> boolean where T: Eq
  Result.contains_err(&this, error: &E) -> boolean where E: Eq
  Result.err(&this) -> Option<E>
  Result.expect(&this, message: string) -> T
  Result.is_err(&this) -> boolean
  Result.is_ok(&this) -> boolean
  Result.map<U>(&this, op: (T) -> U) -> Result<U, E>
  Result.map_err<F>(&this, op: (E) -> F) -> Result<T, F>
  Result.ok(&this) -> Option<T>
  Result.or_else<F>(&this, op: (E) -> Result<T, F>) -> Result<T, F>
  Result.unwrap(&this) -> T
  Result.unwrap_err(&this) -> E
  Result.unwrap_or(&this, default_value: T) -> T
  Result.unwrap_or_else(&this, op: (E) -> T) -> T

  struct Slice<T>

  Slice<T>: implements Index<i32, T>
  Slice<T>: implements Index<i64, T>
  Slice<T>: implements Index<i8, T>

  Slice<T>: implements Index<u64, T>
  Slice<T>: implements Index<u8, T>
  Slice<T>: implements Index<usize, T>

  Slice.element_at(&this, index: u64) -> T*   [private]

  Slice.get_ref(&this, index: i64) -> Option<T*>
  Slice.is_empty(&this) -> boolean

  Slice.length(&this) -> i64
  Slice.subslice(&this, start: i64, end: i64) -> Slice<T>

  struct Arguments
  struct DebugPiece<P, T>   [internal]
  struct DisplayPiece<P, T>   [internal]
  struct LiteralPiece<P>   [internal]
  struct NoPieces   [internal]
  struct SpecPiece<P, T>   [internal]
  trait FormatPieces   [internal]
  DebugPiece<P, T> where P: FormatPieces, T: Debug: implements FormatPieces
  DisplayPiece<P, T> where P: FormatPieces, T: Display: implements FormatPieces
  LiteralPiece<P> where P: FormatPieces: implements FormatPieces
  NoPieces: implements FormatPieces
  SpecPiece<P, T> where P: FormatPieces, T: Display: implements FormatPieces
  fmt_append_debug<T>(out: String, value: &T) -> String where T: Debug   [internal]
  fmt_append_display<T>(out: String, value: &T) -> String where T: Display   [internal]
  fmt_append_fmt<T>(out: String, value: &T, spec: string) -> String where T: Display   [internal]
  fmt_append_lit(out: String, text: string) -> String   [internal]
  fmt_arguments_new(pieces: virtual &FormatPieces) -> Arguments   [internal]
  fmt_new() -> String   [internal]
  fmt_pieces_debug<P, T>(previous: P, value: &T) -> DebugPiece<P, T> where P: FormatPieces, T: Debug   [internal]
  fmt_pieces_display<P, T>(previous: P, value: &T) -> DisplayPiece<P, T> where P: FormatPieces, T: Display   [internal]
  fmt_pieces_literal<P>(previous: P, text: string) -> LiteralPiece<P> where P: FormatPieces   [internal]
  fmt_pieces_new() -> NoPieces   [internal]
  fmt_pieces_spec<P, T>(previous: P, value: &T, spec: string) -> SpecPiece<P, T> where P: FormatPieces, T: Display   [internal]
  Arguments.write_to(&this, f: mut &Formatter) -> Result<(), FmtError>   [internal]
  FormatPieces.write_pieces(&this, f: mut &Formatter) -> Result<(), FmtError>

  struct Bernoulli
  struct Exponential
  struct Normal
  struct UniformF64
  struct UniformI64
  struct UniformU64
  struct WeightedIndex
  trait Distribution<T>
  Bernoulli: implements Distribution<boolean>
  Exponential: implements Distribution<f64>
  Normal: implements Distribution<f64>
  UniformF64: implements Distribution<f64>
  UniformI64: implements Distribution<i64>
  UniformU64: implements Distribution<u64>
  WeightedIndex: implements Distribution<u64>
  WeightedIndex: implements Drop
  Bernoulli::new(p: f64) -> Bernoulli
  Distribution.sample<R>(&this, rng: mut &R) -> T where R: RandomSource
  Exponential::new(lambda: f64) -> Exponential
  Normal::new(mean: f64, std_dev: f64) -> Normal
  UniformF64::new(lo: f64, hi: f64) -> UniformF64
  UniformI64::new(lo: i64, hi: i64) -> UniformI64
  UniformU64::new(lo: u64, hi: u64) -> UniformU64
  WeightedIndex.length(&this) -> i64

  enum MemoryOrder
  struct Atomic<T>
  Atomic<T>: implements Drop
  compiler_fence(order: MemoryOrder) -> void
  fence(order: MemoryOrder) -> void
  Atomic.compare_exchange(mut &this, current: T, next: T, succ: MemoryOrder, fail: MemoryOrder) -> Result<T, T>
  Atomic.fetch_add(mut &this, val: T, order: MemoryOrder) -> T
  Atomic.fetch_and(mut &this, val: T, order: MemoryOrder) -> T
  Atomic.fetch_or(mut &this, val: T, order: MemoryOrder) -> T
  Atomic.fetch_sub(mut &this, val: T, order: MemoryOrder) -> T
  Atomic.fetch_xor(mut &this, val: T, order: MemoryOrder) -> T
  Atomic.load(&this, order: MemoryOrder) -> T
  Atomic.store(mut &this, val: T, order: MemoryOrder) -> void
  Atomic.swap(mut &this, val: T, order: MemoryOrder) -> T
  Atomic::new(initial: T) -> Atomic<T>
  MemoryOrder::to_u32(order: MemoryOrder) -> u32

  enum RecvError
  enum TryRecvError
  struct ChannelInner<T>   [private]
  struct ChannelState<T>   [private]
  struct ChanNode<T>   [private]
  struct Receiver<T>
  struct Sender<T>
  struct SendError<T>
  Receiver<T>: implements Drop
  Sender<T>: implements Drop
  channel<T>() -> Receiver<T>
  free_inner<T>(inner: ChannelInner<T>*) -> void   [private]
  new_inner<T>() -> ChannelInner<T>*   [private]
  release_sender<T>(inner: ChannelInner<T>*) -> void   [private]
  ChannelState.pop(mut &this) -> ChanNode<T>*   [private]
  Receiver.recv(&this) -> Result<T, RecvError>
  Receiver.sender(&this) -> Sender<T>
  Receiver.try_recv(&this) -> Result<T, TryRecvError>
  Sender.clone(&this) -> Sender<T>
  Sender.close(mut this) -> void
  Sender.send(&this, value: T) -> Result<(), SendError<T>>

  mutex_lock_raw(buf: u8*) -> i32   [private]

  struct RwLock<T, A = GlobalAlloc>
  struct RwLockInner<T, A>   [private]
  struct RwLockReadGuard<T, A>
  struct RwLockWriteGuard<T, A>
  RwLock<T, A>: implements Drop
  RwLockReadGuard<T, A>: implements Drop
  RwLockWriteGuard<T, A>: implements Drop
  rwlock_destroy_raw(buf: u8*) -> void   [private]
  rwlock_init_raw(buf: u8*) -> i32   [private]
  rwlock_rdlock_raw(buf: u8*) -> i32   [private]
  rwlock_tryrdlock_raw(buf: u8*) -> i32   [private]
  rwlock_trywrlock_raw(buf: u8*) -> i32   [private]
  rwlock_unlock_exclusive_raw(buf: u8*) -> void   [private]
  rwlock_unlock_shared_raw(buf: u8*) -> void   [private]
  rwlock_wrlock_raw(buf: u8*) -> i32   [private]
  RwLock.read(&this) -> RwLockReadGuard<T, A>
  RwLock.try_read(&this) -> Option<RwLockReadGuard<T, A>>
  RwLock.try_write(&this) -> Option<RwLockWriteGuard<T, A>>
  RwLock.write(&this) -> RwLockWriteGuard<T, A>
  RwLock::new(value: T) -> RwLock<T, GlobalAlloc>
  RwLock::new_in(value: T, alloc: A) -> RwLock<T, A>
  RwLock::try_new(value: T) -> Result<RwLock<T, GlobalAlloc>, AllocError>
  RwLock::try_new_in(value: T, alloc: A) -> Result<RwLock<T, A>, AllocError>
  RwLockReadGuard.as_ptr(&this) -> T*
  RwLockWriteGuard.as_ptr(&this) -> T*

  struct Duration
  Duration: implements Debug
  Duration: implements Display
  Duration: implements Eq
  Duration: implements Ord
  Duration::MICROS_PER_SEC: u64
  Duration::MILLIS_PER_SEC: u64
  Duration::NANOS_PER_MICRO: u64
  Duration::NANOS_PER_MILLI: u64
  Duration::NANOS_PER_SEC: u64
  Duration::SECS_PER_DAY: u64
  Duration::SECS_PER_HOUR: u64
  Duration::SECS_PER_MINUTE: u64
  write_fraction(f: mut &Formatter, nanos: u32) -> Result<(), FmtError>   [private]
  Duration.as_micros(&this) -> u64
  Duration.as_millis(&this) -> u64
  Duration.as_millis_ceil(&this) -> u64
  Duration.as_nanos(&this) -> u64
  Duration.as_secs(&this) -> u64
  Duration.as_secs_f64(&this) -> f64
  Duration.checked_add(&this, other: &Duration) -> Option<Duration>
  Duration.checked_sub(&this, other: &Duration) -> Option<Duration>
  Duration.divide(&this, divisor: u64) -> Duration
  Duration.is_zero(&this) -> boolean
  Duration.mul_f64(&this, factor: f64) -> Duration
  Duration.saturating_add(&this, other: &Duration) -> Duration
  Duration.saturating_sub(&this, other: &Duration) -> Duration
  Duration.scale(&this, factor: u64) -> Duration
  Duration.subsec_micros(&this) -> u32
  Duration.subsec_millis(&this) -> u32
  Duration.subsec_nanos(&this) -> u32
  Duration.to_debug_string(&this) -> String
  Duration.to_string(&this) -> String
  Duration::from_micros(micros: u64) -> Duration
  Duration::from_millis(millis: u64) -> Duration
  Duration::from_nanos(nanos: u64) -> Duration
  Duration::from_secs(secs: u64) -> Duration
  Duration::from_secs_f64(secs: f64) -> Duration
  Duration::microsecond() -> Duration
  Duration::millisecond() -> Duration
  Duration::nanosecond() -> Duration
  Duration::new(secs: u64, nanos: u32) -> Duration
  Duration::second() -> Duration
  Duration::zero() -> Duration
